items.heading: Coq au Vin
details: Key ingredients: chicken, red wine, bacon lardons, mushrooms, pearl onions, garlic
Brown chicken pieces and bacon lardons in a heavy pot.
Add pearl onions, mushrooms and garlic, then pour in red wine to cover.
Simmer gently for about an hour until the chicken is tender.
Reduce the sauce until glossy and serve with crusty bread or potatoes.

items.heading: Ratatouille
details: Key ingredients: eggplant, zucchini, bell peppers, tomatoes, onion, garlic, herbes de Provence
Saute onion and garlic, then add chopped peppers and eggplant.
Add zucchini and tomatoes, seasoning with herbes de Provence.
Simmer uncovered until the vegetables soften and flavors meld.
Serve warm or at room temperature as a side or light main.

items.heading: Creme Brulee
details: Key ingredients: egg yolks, cream, sugar, vanilla
Warm cream with vanilla, then slowly whisk into egg yolks and sugar.
Pour into ramekins and bake in a water bath until just set.
Chill completely, then sprinkle sugar on top.
Caramelize the sugar with a torch or under a broiler just before serving.
